international_aviation.headline: 聯合航空宣布於主要樞紐推出12條全新國內航線
international_aviation.summary: 根據航空媒體報導，聯合航空宣布在其主要樞紐機場啟動大規模的航線擴展計劃，一舉推出12條全新的航線。這批全新航線全部都屬於國內航線，並未包含任何國際航點，該媒體亦提供了對應的航線地圖資訊。
international_aviation.headline_en: United Airlines Launches 12 New Domestic Routes From Major Hub
international_aviation.summary_en: According to an announcement reported by the aviation news outlet Simple Flying, United Airlines is initiating a massive network expansion by launching twelve new routes from one of its major hubs. The report highlights that all of these newly introduced routes are domestic services, meaning that no international destinations are part of this specific service expansion. Additionally, the coverage includes a route map detail to assist passengers in visualizing the upcoming flight network changes.

international_aviation.headline: 加拿大西捷航空客艙組員展開罷工 已致逾三百航班取消
international_aviation.summary: 加拿大西捷航空約4,400名客艙組員因勞資談判破裂，於2026年8月2日正式發動罷工，導致超過300個航班取消。本次罷工主要影響波音737與787機隊營運，爭議焦點集中於起飛前與降落後地面勤務的薪資給付。由Dash 8 Q400營運的WestJet Encore及代碼共享航班則維持正常。
international_aviation.headline_en: WestJet Cabin Crew Launch Strike Following Failed Talks, Over 300 Flights Canceled
international_aviation.summary_en: Approximately 4,400 WestJet flight attendants officially went on strike on August 2, 2026, after nearly 11 months of contract negotiations between the airline and CUPE Local 8125 failed to produce a collective agreement. The strike action has forced WestJet to cancel more than 300 flights across its network, impacting services operated by Boeing 737 and Boeing 787 aircraft. At the heart of the labor dispute is compensation for pre-flight and post-flight duties. Meanwhile, regional flights operated by WestJet Encore using De Havilland Dash 8 Q400 aircraft and partner codeshare services continue to run as scheduled.
